situations.title: 호흡곤란 초기 문진
situations.tagline: I've been having trouble catching my breath since this morning.
situations.brief: 호흡곤란의 발병·악화 요인·기좌호흡 여부를 청취해 초기 병력을 정리하세요.
keyPhrases: When did the shortness of breath start?
Is it worse when you lie down or when you move?
Do you have any cough, fever, or chest pain with it?

situations.title: 산소포화·호흡수 사정 설명
situations.tagline: What's that clip on my finger reading?
situations.brief: 산소포화도·호흡수 측정 과정을 설명하고 산소 적용 필요성을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: This clip measures the oxygen level in your blood.
I'm counting how many breaths you take per minute.
If it's low, we'll give you a little oxygen.

situations.title: 비강 캐뉼라 산소 적용
situations.tagline: These little tubes in my nose feel strange — is this okay?
situations.brief: 비강 캐뉼라의 유량과 착용감을 조정하며 산소 적용을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: The prongs go just inside your nose, gently.
I'm starting the oxygen at a low flow for now.
Let me know if it feels too dry or tickly.

situations.title: 과호흡 증후군 진정 코칭
situations.tagline: I can't breathe, my hands are tingling — I feel like I'm suffocating!
situations.brief: 과호흡 증후군 환자에게 호흡 속도를 늦추도록 진정 코칭을 제공하세요.
keyPhrases: You're safe — let's slow your breathing down together.
Breathe in for four, and out slowly for four with me.
The tingling will ease as your breathing settles.
goals: 과호흡 환자의 호흡 속도를 늦추도록 코칭한다

situations.title: 상기도 감염성 호흡곤란 문진
situations.tagline: I've had a cough and fever for days, and now breathing feels harder.
situations.brief: 발열·인후통·기침 등 상기도 감염 소견을 청취해 호흡곤란 원인을 문진하세요.
keyPhrases: How high has your fever been?
Is the cough bringing anything up?
Does your throat hurt or feel swollen?
goals: 상기도 감염 관련 증상을 체계적으로 청취한다

situations.title: 급성 폐부종 기좌호흡
situations.tagline: I can't lie down at all — I'm coughing up pink, frothy stuff.
situations.brief: 분홍거품가래·수포음·좌위를 확인해 급성 폐부종을 사정하고 좌위를 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's sit you upright to help you breathe.
The pink, frothy cough worries me about fluid in your lungs.
I'm listening to your lungs and getting oxygen on you.
goals: 좌위 유지와 산소 적용으로 호흡을 지지한다

situations.title: 폐렴성 저산소증 사정
situations.tagline: My chest hurts when I breathe and I'm coughing up green gunk.
situations.brief: 발열·화농성 객담·청진 소견을 확인해 폐렴성 저산소증을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: What color is the phlegm you're coughing up?
Does it hurt to take a deep breath?
Your oxygen is a bit low, so we'll give you some.
goals: 폐렴 관련 소견과 객담 양상을 청취한다

situations.title: 폐색전 의심 호흡곤란
situations.tagline: It came on suddenly, it hurts to breathe, and my calf is swollen.
situations.brief: 흉막통·다리부종을 확인해 폐색전 의심 호흡곤란을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Did the shortness of breath start suddenly?
Is one of your legs more swollen or painful?
Have you traveled far or been immobile recently?

situations.title: 비침습환기(BiPAP) 설명
situations.tagline: That mask looks scary — I don't want it strapped to my face.
situations.brief: 비침습환기(BiPAP)의 목적을 설명하고 마스크 공포를 완화하며 적용하세요.
keyPhrases: This mask pushes air in to help you breathe easier.
I'll hold it gently first so you can get used to it.
Try to breathe with the machine — it works with you.

situations.title: 무증상 저산소(행복한 저산소) 인지
situations.tagline: Honestly, I feel fine — I don't know why my numbers are low.
situations.brief: 자각 증상 없이 SpO2가 낮은 무증상 저산소를 인지하고 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Your oxygen is lower than we'd like, even though you feel okay.
Let me recheck it and watch you take a few breaths.
We'll give oxygen and keep a close eye on you.

situations.title: 흉수·기흉 감별 문진
situations.tagline: The right side of my chest feels tight and I can't breathe deep.
situations.brief: 편측 호흡음 감소를 확인해 흉수·기흉을 감별 문진하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm listening to both sides of your chest to compare.
Did the tightness come on suddenly or gradually?
Point to exactly where it feels tight.

situations.title: 언어장벽 호흡곤란 핵심
situations.tagline: No... respirar... difícil.
situations.brief: 언어장벽 호흡곤란 환자에게 예/아니오로 통증·질식감·알레르기를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Chest pain? Yes or no?
Choking feeling? Point to your throat, yes or no?
Allergy to medicine? An interpreter is on the way.
goals: 폐쇄형 질문으로 호흡곤란 핵심 증상을 확인한다

situations.title: 신경근질환 환기저하
situations.tagline: My muscles are so weak lately, and now my cough is really feeble.
situations.brief: 약한 기침·삼킴장애를 확인해 신경근질환에 의한 환기저하를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Has your cough gotten weaker over the past few days?
Are you having trouble swallowing or clearing your throat?
We need to watch your breathing muscles closely.

situations.title: 산소요법 목표치 소통
situations.tagline: Can't you just turn my oxygen all the way up so I feel better?
situations.brief: COPD 과산소 위험을 설명하고 산소요법 목표치를 환자와 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: For you, too much oxygen can actually be harmful.
We aim for a target range, not the highest number.
I'll adjust it carefully to keep you in the safe zone.

situations.title: 불안 동반 호흡곤란 감별
situations.tagline: I feel like I can't get enough air, but the doctor says my lungs are fine.
situations.brief: 기질적 원인을 배제하며 불안 동반 호흡곤란을 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Your oxygen and lung exam look reassuring.
Does this happen when you feel stressed or anxious?
Let's slow your breathing and see if it eases.

situations.title: 상기도 폐쇄 급성 대응
situations.tagline: *high-pitched wheeze* ...can't... swallow... drooling...
situations.brief: 천명·침흘림·어려운 기도 징후를 인지하고 상기도 폐쇄에 응급 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: That high-pitched sound worries me about your airway.
I'm calling for airway help right now — stay calm.
We're keeping you upright and getting oxygen ready.
goals: 천명·침흘림 등 상기도 폐쇄 징후를 인지한다
어려운 기도에 대비해 즉시 응급 자원을 동원한다

situations.title: 기관삽관 준비·RSI 보조
situations.tagline: We're going to have to intubate — get everything ready.
situations.brief: RSI 약물·장비·흡인을 준비하고 콜아웃으로 기관삽관을 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: Suction is on, blade and tube are ready.
Induction and paralytic drawn up and labeled.
Sats are 98, we're good to go — go ahead.

situations.title: I형 호흡부전 급속 악화
situations.tagline: His sats just dropped to the seventies even on high-flow oxygen.
situations.brief: 산소에도 SpO2가 급락하는 I형 호흡부전에서 삽관 결정을 신속히 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: He's not responding to oxygen — sats keep falling.
We need to move toward intubation now.
I'm calling the team and preparing the airway.
goals: 삽관 결정과 팀 동원을 신속히 조율한다

situations.title: 후두부종 아나필락시스 기도
situations.tagline: Her lips and tongue are swelling — she can barely get words out.
situations.brief: 아나필락시스 후두부종에서 에피네프린과 응급기도를 동시에 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Give IM epinephrine now — her airway is closing.
Call for the difficult airway cart and ENT.
Have a surgical airway kit open at the bedside.

situations.title: 삽관 후 갑작스런 악화(DOPE)
situations.tagline: He was stable, but now his sats are crashing after intubation.
situations.brief: 삽관 후 급성 악화 시 DOPE를 계통적으로 점검하세요.
keyPhrases: Run through DOPE — displacement, obstruction, pneumothorax, equipment.
Check the tube position and suction for a plug.
Listen for equal breath sounds and check the ventilator.
goals: 삽관 후 악화를 DOPE로 계통 점검한다

situations.title: 대량 객혈 기도확보
situations.tagline: He's coughing up a lot of blood and choking on it.
situations.brief: 대량 객혈 환자에서 흡인·측위·출혈측 관리로 기도를 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Suction continuously to keep the airway clear.
Position him with the bleeding side down.
Prepare to intubate and call for help now.

situations.title: 기관절개 튜브 폐쇄·이탈
situations.tagline: My trach isn't working — I can't breathe through it!
situations.brief: 기관절개 튜브의 폐쇄·이탈을 인지하고 응급 흡인·교체를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm suctioning your trach to clear any blockage.
If it's out of place, we'll change the tube right away.
Try to stay calm — we're giving you oxygen now.
goals: 응급 흡인과 튜브 교체를 신속히 준비한다
